question: Could you describe an example of a time this week when you had to switch your attention?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “On Thursday, I was sorting mysteries and someone asked me about a cookbook. Cookbooks sometimes come in with lovely old covers… (laughs a little) Anyway, I put the mystery I was holding on the cookery shelf. I wasn’t just being careless—I’d got caught up in their question.”
